data.name: Sunnah
data.long_meaning: The customary way or practice of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) which serves as a model for Muslims to follow in their daily lives.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the teachings and practices of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), guiding Muslims towards a righteous and virtuous life.

data.cultural_impact: The Sunnah refers to the actions, sayings, approvals, and disapprovals of Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him), which serve as a guidance for Muslims to lead their lives. It preserves the Islamic identity by providing a common standard for Muslims to follow in their religious, social, and cultural practices. Sunnah is deeply ingrained in Islamic culture and is the foundation upon which Islamic legal and ethical principles are based.
data.spiritual_significance: The Sunnah is considered the second source of Islamic law after the Quran. It provides Muslims with practical examples of how to apply the teachings of the Quran in their daily lives. Through following the Sunnah, Muslims seek to draw closer to Allah (God) and develop a deeper spiritual connection with Him. It is a reminder of the Prophet's (peace be upon him) life and teachings, which continue to inspire and guide Muslims till this day.
